title: Jaipur blue pottery at a glance
description: Four headline figures of Jaipur blue pottery: its authorised GI users, the days a piece takes, its single firing and the year of its GI application.

u0002.text: 15 days for a piece or a batch

C043.text: Blue pottery needs only one firing for both baking and glazing, unlike clay pottery, which needs two firings.

quotes.quote: Requires only one firing for baking and glazing unlike clay pottery where two firings are required.
Jaipur potters do not bisque fire their wares

C133.text: A Kot Jewar artisan family told The Federal that a piece of blue pottery takes around 15 days to complete, whether a single plate or a batch of one hundred.

quotes.quote: Creating a single piece of blue pottery takes around 15 days to complete, whether it's a single plate or a batch of one hundred.

C135.text: Blue Pottery of Jaipur was filed for registration as geographical indication application 66 by the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) on 14 August 2006.
